generate_anchor_boxes: generate a matrix of anchor boxes in x1 y1 x2 y2 format with custom stride sizes and aspect ratios
generate_anchors_with_ratios: generate anchor reference windows by enumerating aspect ratios and scales for a reference window
compute_anchor_center: compute the width height x center and y center for a given anchor window
build_anchors_from_dimensions: build a set of anchor windows from vectors of widths and heights around a center point
enumerate_anchor_scales: enumerate a set of anchors for each scale relative to a given anchor window
